mutants.description: Supervisor's S_RUN overcurrent exit takes the live synchronised CP comparator instead of fault_arbiter's RUN window trip, so the rolling-window duration filter is bypassed for the FSM
mutants.reason: In S_RUN, any CP_trig assertion that reaches CP_sync, even a single cycle well below trip_run faulted cycles, moves the FSM to S_HICCUP on the next edge. En drops and a strike is counted where the original keeps running until the window count reaches trip_run.

mutants.description: Supervisor's soft-start overcurrent exit takes the live synchronised CP comparator instead of fault_arbiter's soft-start window trip, so the higher soft-start tolerance trip_ss is never applied
mutants.reason: In S_SS, the first CP_trig excursion, which is expected while the output capacitor charges, sends the FSM to S_HICCUP. En drops and the ramp aborts, where the original only does so once trip_ss faulted cycles have been seen in the window.

mutants.description: The valley-current comparator is taken as active low (open-drain fault convention) at fault_arbiter, so a low CP_trig counts as an overcurrent cycle
mutants.reason: With CP_trig low (no overcurrent), every switching cycle in S_SS is sampled as faulted, so window_trip_SS fires after trip_ss cycles and the converter hiccups on every start. A real sustained overcurrent (CP_trig high) never trips either window.

mutants.description: The UVLO comparator is read as an 'input good' signal (high when the input rail is above threshold), so its synchronised level is inverted before debouncing
mutants.reason: With a healthy input (UVLO_trig low), UVLO_sync_db stays asserted. The supervisor never leaves S_OFF, En stays low and Red_LED3 stays lit. An actual undervoltage (UVLO_trig high) releases the flag and lets the converter start.

mutants.description: The SCR latch read-back is taken as active low (the anode node pulled down when the SCR fires), so the synchronised read-back is inverted before debouncing
mutants.reason: With the latch not tripped (latch_stat low), latch_stat_sync_db stays set. The supervisor stays in S_OFF, Red_LED1 is solid and the STATUS latch bit reads set. A real latch trip (latch_stat high) clears it and lets the converter run.
